description: Repairs r-cursor-1/pages-traverse-table and pages-traverse-dynaset: storage order equalled ID order, so the table-type and the dynaset walks could not be told apart (page emptiness itself is not observable here). Table M2 held IDs 512 down to 1 inserted in descending order with a nonunique index IX_M2 (ID), and then lost IDs 1-100, 200-320 and 450-512. For each of [table-type, no Index (storage order); table-type, Index IX_M2 (key order); dynaset on the table name; dynaset on SELECT * FROM M2 ORDER BY ID]: open it (Index set where named), read RecordCount, read ID through a held Field at each row by MoveNext until EOF (at most 600), read BOF and EOF, then MoveLast and read ID by MovePrevious until BOF (at most 600), then BOF, EOF and RecordCount. Asks the visited row sequence and the boundary reports in both directions across empty pages when storage order and key order differ, per recordset type. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
